title: Matchings and product growth in modular abelian independence groups
summary: We unify two matching theories, one for finite subsets of groups and the other for finite-dimensional subspaces in a field extension. To achieve this, we study groups equipped with a compatible finitary matroid structure, termed here independence groups. Applying Rado's independent transversal theorem, we derive necessary and sufficient rank criteria for matchability between finite-rank sets.
